title: AiBeasts
tagline: AIBeasts, a strategy game where you train your AI monster and fight players around the world! Shape its abilities and style, and battle other players for rewards. No limits to what you can imagine!
description:
AIBeasts is an AI-powered crypto strategy game where players create, train, and battle custom AI Beasts to win experience and ETH, while keep on evolving their creatures. Each Beast is uniquely crafted by the user, with its own set of abilities, strengths, and weaknesses, and players must train them to develop battle strategies and decision-making skills. Players can teach them whatever they want.

How It Works
Create & Customize Your Beast
Players start by generating an AI Beast, customizing its attributes, and choosing its playstyle. Every Beast has a distinct combat style, making training a crucial part of progression. 

Train Your AI Beast
Training involves teaching the AI how to filter powers, adapt to opponents, and improve tactics. Players refine their Beast’s strategy through practice battles and AI-driven learning loops, ensuring that no two Beasts fight the same way. The more they play, the more they can improve the skills.

Battle for ETH & Rewards
Players can enter free matches or PVP battles, staking ETH for winner-takes-it-all matches. The battles are fully autonomous, meaning the AI controls the fight based on its training. There is an AI judge system ensuring fair competition, evaluating combat outcomes without bias, and paying the winner user directly to their connected wallet.

Evolve & Upgrade
Victories earn ETH and experience points, allowing players to unlock new powers, battle strategies, and optimizations. The more a Beast fights, the smarter and stronger it becomes, continuously adapting to new playstyles and meta shifts.

AIBeasts is more than just a game—it’s an ever-evolving AI battleground. Each fight refines the AI models, and the competition pushes Beasts to new strategic limits. The battle judge AI is an ongoing challenge, requiring careful training to ensure fair and balanced fights.

At its core, AIBeasts is about creating, competing, and mastering AI-driven combat, where the best-trained Beast dominates.

This is only an alpha version of AIBeasts and we have big ambitions for the project on keep on improving it, in specific with a leaderboard of winners, vast improvements on the battle terminal, better prompting, and to completely reshape the visual arena of the fights, with AI animations and different environmnents.
how_its_made:
AIBeasts is built for L2 chains, in specific for Arbitrum and Base, using Alchemy for RPCs to ensure smooth blockchain interactions. The frontend runs on React with Vite, while VortexConnect (our own system) handles wallet connections via ethers v6. Smart contracts are developed using Hardhat and deployed on the Sepolia testnet, Arbitrum Mainnet and Base.

For off-chain data management, Supabase stores lobbies, bets, and battle history, with JWT encryption securing user authentication. The backend runs on Vercel serverless functions, efficiently processing game logic and blockchain events. OpenAI’s GPT-4 and 3.5 models power AI-generated battle commentary, while Flux generates dynamic battle visuals.

This tech stack seamlessly integrates web3 gaming, AI-generated content, and decentralized betting, making AIBeasts an immersive and innovative experience.

To create the AI training, we had to "teach" the models how to filter and categorize each power correctly before adding them to the database. This required extensive tuning to ensure the system understands and ranks abilities fairly.

The battle process also demanded careful AI training to ensure a balanced and fair game, especially when preparing the judge to make unbiased decisions. This aspect is still a work in progress, as we continue refining how the AI evaluates and moderates battles dynamically.
